machineChecked: policy category keys exist in token-catalog (verify_all.py token-policy)
convention: no raw hex/px in generated styling

overrides: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance style/token-override field: styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts. There is therefore nothing token-related to validate at the PageSpec layer; adding such a field would need a new schema property + validator rule (deliberately not invented).

rawValueRestrictions.color: Never emit a raw hex/rgb; resolve through tokens.10-semantic.color-roles (all values exist in tailwind.config.js). No new colors.
rawValueRestrictions.gradient: Only the 3 section gradients and 6 modal gradients in tokens.00-foundation.gradient.
rawValueRestrictions.typography: Only Cadiz cuts (by family, never by font-weight — see weightQuirk) and Recoleta 'serif'. Keep the unlayered h1/desktop-*/mobile-* rules unlayered.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Only the closed motion patterns; no scroll-reveal (none exists on the original).
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: sm 640 / md 768 / lg 992 / xl 1280 / 2xl 1440 plus raw 960/961/639 queries for FAQ, table and blog scroller.
